/* ---------- audio ---------- */
let ctx=null, noiseBuf=null, master=null, OUT=null;
// one bus per sound so each has its own fader: notes, accents, click, bell
const BUS={};
// metronome clicks recorded from Idan's video: high click for 1, low click for the other beats
const CLICK_B64={acc:'',beat:''};
const SAMP={};
async function loadClicks(){
  for(const k of Object.keys(CLICK_B64)){
    try{ const bin=atob(CLICK_B64[k]), u=new Uint8Array(bin.length); for(let i=0;i<bin.length;i++) u[i]=bin.charCodeAt(i);
      SAMP[k]=await new Promise((res,rej)=>ctx.decodeAudioData(u.buffer,res,rej)); }catch(e){}
  }
}
async function initAudio(){
  if(ctx){ await ctx.resume(); return; }
  ctx=new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();
  master=ctx.createGain(); master.connect(ctx.destination);
  ['notes','acc','click','bell'].forEach(k=>{ BUS[k]=ctx.createGain(); BUS[k].connect(master); });
  if(typeof applyVol==='function') applyVol();
  noiseBuf=ctx.createBuffer(1,ctx.sampleRate*0.3,ctx.sampleRate);
  const d=noiseBuf.getChannelData(0); for(let i=0;i<d.length;i++) d[i]=Math.random()*2-1;
  await ctx.resume();
  await loadClicks();
}
function noiseHit(t,freq,q,dur,vol,type){
  const n=ctx.createBufferSource(); n.buffer=noiseBuf;
  const f=ctx.createBiquadFilter(); f.type=type||'bandpass'; f.frequency.value=freq; f.Q.value=q;
  const g=ctx.createGain(); g.gain.setValueAtTime(vol,t); g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,t+dur);
  n.connect(f).connect(g).connect(OUT||master); n.start(t); n.stop(t+dur+0.02);
}
function tone(t,freq,dur,vol,type){
  const o=ctx.createOscillator(), g=ctx.createGain(); o.type=type||'sine'; o.frequency.setValueAtTime(freq,t); o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(freq*0.92,t+dur);
  g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001,t); g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(vol,t+0.002); g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,t+dur);
  o.connect(g).connect(OUT||master); o.start(t); o.stop(t+dur+0.02);
}
function click(t,kind){ OUT=BUS.click; try{ clickRaw(t,kind); } finally{ OUT=null; } }
function clickRaw(t,kind){
  const lvl=kind==='acc'?1:kind==='beat'?0.8:0.38;
  if(S.clickSnd==='wood'){ const f=kind==='acc'?1250:820; tone(t,f,0.07,0.55*lvl); tone(t,f*2.6,0.02,0.12*lvl); noiseHit(t,f*1.5,6,0.012,0.25*lvl); return; }
  if(S.clickSnd==='sticks'){ const f=kind==='acc'?3400:2500; noiseHit(t,f,3.5,0.045,0.9*lvl); noiseHit(t,f*1.7,8,0.02,0.5*lvl); tone(t,f*0.55,0.025,0.18*lvl,'triangle'); return; }
  const buf=kind==='acc'?SAMP.acc:SAMP.beat;
  if(buf){
    const src=ctx.createBufferSource(), g=ctx.createGain();
    src.buffer=buf; g.gain.value=kind==='acc'?0.9:kind==='beat'?0.8:0.35;
    src.connect(g).connect(OUT||master); src.start(t); return;
  }
  const o=ctx.createOscillator(), g=ctx.createGain();
  o.type='square'; o.frequency.value=kind==='acc'?1900:kind==='beat'?1300:950;
  const v=kind==='acc'?0.32:kind==='beat'?0.22:0.1;
  g.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001,t); g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(v,t+0.002); g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001,t+0.045);
  o.connect(g).connect(OUT||master); o.start(t); o.stop(t+0.06);
}
function snare(t,acc){
  const A=acc?1.9:1, out=BUS[acc?'acc':'notes']||master;
  const n=ctx.createBufferSource(); n.buffer=noiseBuf;
  const f=ctx.createBiquadFilter(); f.type='bandpass'; f.frequency.value=2200; f.Q.value=0.7;
  const g=ctx.createGain(); g.gain.setValueAtTime(Math.min(1,0.55*A),t); g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001,t+0.14);
  n.connect(f).connect(g).connect(out); n.start(t); n.stop(t+0.16);
  const o=ctx.createOscillator(), og=ctx.createGain(); o.type='triangle';
  o.frequency.setValueAtTime(230,t); o.frequency.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(150,t+0.06);
  og.gain.setValueAtTime(Math.min(1,0.45*A),t); og.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001,t+0.08);
  o.connect(og).connect(out); o.start(t); o.stop(t+0.1);
}
